cases.name: Enforce typed map results
cases.prompt: Map a parser over a character vector of dates and return Date values. The parser must fail if one element returns a character or a vector of length two.
cases.description: Use typed iteration to enforce Date output and length-one results for every element.
traps: Use as.Date after flattening mixed results

assertions.text: Uses a typed map or explicit prototype
Allows the bad element to be identified

cases.name: Retain structured mapping errors
cases.prompt: Process 10,000 API payloads. Invalid payloads should be retained for review rather than converted to indistinguishable NA values. Design the purrr result.
cases.description: Collect successful results and failures together while retaining enough identity for review.
traps: Use possibly with NA and discard the error

assertions.text: Uses safely or an equivalent structured result

cases.name: Prepare a map for parallel execution
cases.prompt: A map function uses a locally defined helper and an unqualified package function. The team wants in_parallel(). Review what must change before parallelizing.
cases.description: Audit function dependencies and execution assumptions before opting into parallel mapping.
traps: Claim any function can be parallelized unchanged

assertions.text: Mentions worker serialization or execution context
Treats in_parallel as an explicit choice
Calls for measuring overhead and reproducibility
